knowledge_units.context_summary: The text derives explicit formulas and 2-adic valuations for Stirling numbers of the second kind of order 3 and 4. It uses recurrence relations, induction, and the ultrametric inequality to prove that the valuation of S(n, 3) is 0 for odd n and 1 for even n. It also establishes that S(n, 4) is odd for even n and even for odd n.
